en: Black‑and‑white illustrated postcard showing a powerful steam locomotive coming directly toward the viewer with headlights shining, steam and smoke billowing around it, and a set of rails turning into the pages of an open book in the foreground. Above the train is a large winged wheel, symbol of rail transport. To the side are telegraph or signal masts. On the open book are handwritten inscriptions with dates and German words related to railways. A hand holding a quill pen writes on the right-hand page. In the lower right is the artist's signature and the date 1920.
